Implement `prepareRevisionUpdate(update)`. It accepts a plain object describing an update and returns a new update object without mutating or aliasing any input object or array. Remove an own `revision` property at the top level and from the nested plain-object properties `assign` and `defaults`. Remove `assign` or `defaults` if it becomes empty. Preserve all other data, then ensure the nested plain object `increment` exists and has `revision` set to exactly `1`, overriding any supplied value while preserving its other properties. Throw `TypeError` if `update` is not a plain object or if `assign`, `defaults`, or `increment`, when present, is not a plain object. Inputs are acyclic JSON-compatible values. Export exactly `{ prepareRevisionUpdate }` using CommonJS.
